2153. Printing a Countdown Using Recursion

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print the numbers from N down to 1 using a recursive function.

Description
A recursive function is a function that calls itself. Read an integer N from input. Write a void function countdown that takes an integer parameter n. If n is at least 1, the function prints n and then calls itself with n - 1. When n becomes 0, the function does nothing and the recursion stops. Call countdown from main() with N. No loop should be used.
input_spec:
. Write a void function countdown that takes an integer parameter n. If n is at least 1, the function prints n and then calls itself with n - 1. When n becomes 0, the function does nothing and the recursion stops. Call countdown from main() with N. No loop should be used.

Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
output_spec: Print the numbers from N down to 1, each on its own line.
